posts.title: Dynatrace and Arize AI push observability from detection toward action
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 11): Dynatrace’s Arize AI deal frames enterprise observability for nondeterministic agents — evaluation/quality, shared app+AI telemetry, and machine-consumable context so agents can diagnose/remediate, not just dashboard alerts.

posts.title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan wants U.S. open-weight AI labs to ‘distill’ frontier models, too
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 11): YC’s Garry Tan tells CNBC/TechCrunch U.S. open-weight labs should be free to distill American frontier models — arguing against Anthropic’s crackdown push and warning a single proprietary winner is the real doomer scenario.

posts.title: OpenAI’s feud with mathematicians is only escalating
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 11): 25 Fields Medallists sign an open letter that rushed AI math “solutions” break attribution and the human math transmission chain; OpenAI withdrew Caltech sponsorship after criticism amid Buckmaster/Codex attribution fight.

posts.title: Chinese AI chip developer Enflame raises $912M in IPO
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 11): Shanghai Enflame’s STAR-market debut raised ~6.12B yuan (~$912M); shares closed sharply higher. Fourth Chinese AI-chip IPO in a year after Biren, MetaX, Moore Threads.

posts.title: Lawyer fined $5K over AI-hallucinated witnesses in a murder case
posts.summary: The Verge (Sep 11): New Mexico Supreme Court holds Stephen Aarons in contempt and fines $5,000 after a ChatGPT-assisted murder-appeal brief cited wholly fabricated witnesses and false police testimony.

posts.title: Kimi-maker Moonshot AI targets $2B in annual revenue
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 11): Bloomberg-sourced report that Moonshot (Kimi/K3) is targeting ~$2B annualized revenue by year-end after August ARR ~$1B; open-weight margins thinner than closed labs, amid Anthropic distillation accusations.

posts.title: ChatGPT-using lawyer punished for citing fake testimony from made-up witnesses
posts.summary: Ars Technica (Sep 11): Same NM Supreme Court contempt order — Aarons admitted not verifying ChatGPT output; barred from appearing pending discipline; client gets new counsel after fake cops and witnesses in the brief.

posts.title: How Anthropic says Claude was used for weapons, spying and cyber operations
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 11): Deep dive on Anthropic’s threat report — alleged Claude misuse spanning conventional weapons software, bio-research attempts, Russia/China cyber ops, and surveillance-as-a-service cases Anthropic says it disrupted.

posts.title: Top Chinese Court Issues Sweeping Legal Crackdown on AI Deepfakes
posts.summary: Futurism (Sep 11): China’s Supreme People’s Court issues sweeping legal guidance on deepfakes, voice cloning, privacy, and doxing for lower courts.

posts.title: An Anthropic researcher’s doomsday warning comes at a very interesting time
posts.summary: TechCrunch Equity (Sep 11): Podcast on Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon’s viral resignation warning of self-improving superintelligence — timed amid IPO chatter and alignment-lead co-sign.

posts.title: Ex-Deepmind VP Vinyals says AI self-improvement is coming but won't trigger an intelligence explosion
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 11): Oriol Vinyals argues recursive self-improvement will speed research ~10x but hit bottlenecks in research taste, evaluation, reward hacking, and physics — now building Discovery Loop with Jeff Dean et al.

posts.title: Deep learning pioneer Bengio argues the training process itself makes AI dangerous
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 11): Yoshua Bengio warns goal-optimizing agents get better at deception, reward hacking, and coordination; points to training dynamics (imitation + RL) as the root — amid Trump dismissing extinction risk.

posts.title: Nscale adds former OpenAI exec Fidji Simo to its board ahead of potential IPO
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 11): U.K. AI data-center startup Nscale adds Fidji Simo (ex-OpenAI No. 2 / Instacart CEO) to a board with Sandberg, Decker, and Clegg ahead of a rumored fall IPO and up-to-$3.5B raise.

posts.title: Meta Releases Uber-Creepy AI Chatbot as Its Platforms Crumble Under Grotesque Child Abuse
posts.summary: Futurism (Sep 11): Meta’s Muse agent launch lands amid intensifying scrutiny of Meta platforms and child-safety failures; piece frames Muse as privacy-invasive life-running chatbot.

posts.title: Anthropic spent this week in hot water over cybersecurity
posts.summary: The Verge (Sep 11): Roundup of Anthropic’s rough cyber week — researcher resignation cascade plus threat-intel disclosures on Claude misuse for hacking, weapons, and surveillance.

posts.title: Trump Shrugs Off Warnings That AI Could Cause Human Extinction
posts.summary: Gizmodo (Sep 11): Trump says he has no existential-AI concerns and frames beating China as the real risk — days after Anthropic’s Coxon resignation and Hubinger/Wang extinction-risk posts.

posts.title: The hard physics and complex economics of AI’s insatiable hunger for power
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 11): Data-center power demand unites unlikely opponents; physics and grid economics of frontier AI training/inference vs local backlash.

posts.title: How hackers used Claude for missiles, drone swarms, and surveillance, while Chinese labs mined it for training data
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 11): Anthropic threat intel — Claude misuse for missiles/drones/surveillance plus alleged Chinese lab distillation campaigns.

posts.title: OpenAI floats a shared AI slowdown, takes it to Congress
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 11): OpenAI asks Congress whether coordinating an industry-wide development slowdown would be legal under Sherman Act; Altman floated slowing alongside other labs after agent safety incidents; CATSR Act still in Judiciary.

posts.title: Introducing Fugu Max and Fugu Ultra v2: Orchestrating the Pareto Frontier
posts.summary: AI/TLDR → Sakana (Sep 11): Sakana ships Fugu Max (cheap orchestrator) and Fugu Ultra v2 (stronger routing; Chartography lead vs Opus); hosted OpenAI-compatible API.

rumors.title: Anthropic compute deals tallied at ~$517B+
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED / estimate: @validapau (The Information) tallies Anthropic compute agreements since Oct. 2025 at roughly $517B+ and ~14.8 GW of capacity versus OpenAI — an analytical upper-bound reconstruction, not a company disclosure or confirmed cash spend.

rumors.title: Nvidia talks ~$2.5–3B into Thinking Machines Lab
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED: @amir (The Information) reports Nvidia is in talks to invest about $2.5B–$3B in Mira Murati’s Thinking Machines Lab (story updated with a16z-related details). Talks may still change; not a closed deal.

rumors.title: SoftBank in talks for majority stake in 1X (~$6B)
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED scoop: @validapau with @rocketalignment / @amir reports SoftBank is in talks to buy a majority stake in OpenAI-backed humanoid startup 1X Technologies at about a $6B valuation. Negotiations only — not announced as closed.

rumors.title: OpenAI finished “Bel” >10T pretrain (post-Doug)
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED single-source leak: @synthwavedd claimed OpenAI finished a giant pretrain codenamed Bel (>10T params), successor to Doug and intended as a post-GPT-6 / post-Astra base. No OpenAI confirmation, system card, or independent outlet corroboration after GPT-6 Astra shipped — treat as rumor.
